title: Daily News Quiz · 2026-09-15
headline: One in nine migratory birds is threatened with extinction, a global report says

questions.prompt: Who published the State of the World's Birds report?
questions.hintKo: The report comes from BirdLife International, a conservation science organization.

questions.prompt: What share of migratory bird species are in decline, according to the report?
questions.hintKo: The decline figure in the report is forty-five percent.

questions.prompt: When was the slender-billed curlew declared extinct?
questions.hintKo: The curlew was declared extinct last year, the first such loss in mainland Europe and Africa in recent centuries.

questions.prompt: Where did governments and scientists sign the new flyways pledge?
choices: At a summit in Nairobi, Kenya
In a laboratory on the Moon
Inside a shopping centre in Madrid
questions.hintKo: The pledge was signed in Nairobi, Kenya.

questions.prompt: Why are seabirds and shorebirds doing especially badly?
choices: They depend on ocean habitats and coastal wetlands that are damaged
questions.hintKo: These birds suffer because their ocean and coastal habitats are damaged.

questions.prompt: How much money will the development banks put into protecting habitats along migration routes?
questions.hintKo: The banking pledge is about six billion dollars.
